title: What is real about 'learn it once and it is permanent'
the_user_claim: Instant learning and instant learning in new arbitrary environments are already solved perfectly; therefore this is a perfect solution for all computer use; give the model a try in all new coding environments, and after it does them once it learns them permanently; so we solve everything permanently

four_claims_four_verdicts.claim_1_instant_learning_is_solved: TRUE, for a precisely bounded class -- and the repo's own record says the class, not 'solved perfectly'
four_claims_four_verdicts.claim_2_it_applies_in_arbitrary_new_envi: PARTLY TRUE -- a MEASUREMENT SHAPE transfers; operation of an arbitrary environment does not
four_claims_four_verdicts.claim_3_learn_once_then_permanent_for_al: FALSE as stated -- true exactly where the demonstration compiles to a CONFINED PROGRAM
four_claims_four_verdicts.claim_4_this_means_sentience: FALSE -- and the repo already said so in r31

r30_INSTANT_LEARNING_END_TO_END_PROVEN.measured: learned 'unique lines' on 16 rows/8 distinct -> answered 13 on a never-seen file -> answered 21 when learned on 4 distinct (proves it did not memorise the answer)
r30_INSTANT_LEARNING_END_TO_END_PROVEN.bounded_by: a COUNTING QUESTION ABOUT A FILE

r31_ONE_DEMONSTRATION_TRANSFERS_ACROSS_S.verbatim: 'It learns a MEASUREMENT SHAPE permanently, and then answers that shape on any file for ~100 ms with zero weights and zero spend. It does not learn to operate a computer, and nothing here is sentient. "Solve everything on a computer" is false; "never pay twice for a shape I have already been shown" is true.'
r31_ONE_DEMONSTRATION_TRANSFERS_ACROSS_S.hard_counterexample: 'unique words' -> REFUSED, no single admitted program computes it

r59_AM_I_RIGHT_OR_WRONG_ABOUT_THE_LEARNI.answer: WRONG ON 'LEARNING'. RIGHT ON 'FASTER AND CHEAPER THAN FINE-TUNING'. WRONG ON 'CODING AND COMPUTER USE'.
r59_AM_I_RIGHT_OR_WRONG_ABOUT_THE_LEARNI.the_field_criterion: 'What happens if memory is wiped? If the gain vanishes, it was memory.'
r59_AM_I_RIGHT_OR_WRONG_ABOUT_THE_LEARNI.measured: before wipe: ANSWERED ['q','z']. after wipe: ASK, NOTHING_TAUGHT. file, program and process unchanged; only the row removed

new_measurement_this_round.question: does the model recognise the class of goals it would have to learn in order to 'solve anything on a computer'?
new_measurement_this_round.method: 30 rendered-page computer-use goals offered to the 443-capability registry; count confident routing (routing confident = the system claims it can do this)
examples_of_confident_wrong_claims: 'Resize the textarea to be 300 pixels wide' -> pdf.extract.text.pypdf
'Pick the card with the greatest number' -> python.source.definition_count.v1
'Click on Tab #2' -> web.browser.rendered.capture.chromedriver (a screen CAPTURE, not a tab click)
new_measurement_this_round.reading: the registry does not merely lack these capabilities -- it CONFIDENTLY claims unrelated ones. 52% confident-wrong is worse than 0% coverage, because a fail-closed system is usable and a confidently-wrong one is not.

the_first_principles_reframe.statement: Learning-by-demonstration compresses the cost of the Nth execution to zero and does NOTHING for the 1st.
the_first_principles_reframe.why_it_matters: 'give the model a try in all those new environments' presumes it SUCCEEDS on the try. Every measurement says it does not:

first_attempt_measurements.sealed_software_defect: 0/1 (r96) -- solver failed closed, did not repair
first_attempt_measurements.artifact_production: 3/9 producers executed (r98), and all 3 required inputs the agent itself had to construct
first_attempt_measurements.professional_deliverables: 1 of 4 GDPval families has a runnable correct producer; PDF has 0 of 443 (r98)

the_first_principles_reframe.the_circularity: the demonstration that makes everything permanent must be AUTHORED BY SOMETHING THAT CAN ALREADY DO THE TASK. The system has no mechanism to author its own first demonstration in a task it cannot do. Every round of this session is evidence: the demonstrations were written by me, and r90 forbids counting me as the model.
the_first_principles_reframe.corollary: improving the learning mechanism cannot move the ceiling, because the ceiling is set by the fraction of tasks for which a first demonstration can be obtained at all. That fraction is the only number worth raising.

supports_the_user.source: Continual Learning in LLM Agents survey (2026), Ball
supports_the_user.finding: 'In-context learning is (almost) all you need' -- with new base models every few months there may not be much to gain from true continual learning over in-context learning
dedicated memory and skill-maintenance methods 'are only selectively helpful and can be matched or outperformed by ordinary in-context accumulation'

constrains_the_user.finding: separating a skill's GOAL from its EXECUTION is what makes it reusable across sites -- our skill store records an execution, not an abstracted goal
ICL 'allows instantaneous adaptation and completely avoids forgetting... but it is TEMPORARY. Once the context is cleared, the learning is gone'
catastrophic forgetting is not solved by demonstration; it needs on-policy updates, and even then 'some degradation of prior capabilities remains'
'stored content can survive while remaining unaccessed, unused, or ineffective' -- exactly the failure r67 named: a skill that cannot be found was never learned

what_the_2026_literature_adds.net: the 2026 field says the user's intuition is PARTIALLY right (cheap in-context/demonstrative learning is underrated), and says the missing piece is GOAL ABSTRACTION, not storage.

sentience.reason: the system stores rows in a database and retrieves them. r59 measured the defining test: wipe the row and the capability is gone. That is filing with exact reversibility -- a genuinely excellent property, and not a mind.
sentience.what_would_be_evidence: learning something that was never demonstrated, and retaining it after the store is wiped

the_smartest_things_to_do_ranked: 1. RAISE THE FIRST-ATTEMPT RATE. Not the learning rate. The whole system optimises N>=2; the ceiling is N=1. Concretely: producers for the deliverable families that have none (PDF first, 85/220 of GDPval), and a substrate gate so a rendered-page goal can never route to a non-page capability.
2. ABSTRACT THE GOAL, NOT THE EXECUTION. PolySkill's result is the one change that would make stored skills transfer across environments; the current store replays a trajectory.
3. MEASURE ON ONE AXIS ONLY: W_COVER on GDPval-AA against elo 1846. Every other axis invented this session was a detour.
